g.text: Whisper runners on Apple Silicon, one clip

One 935s clip (n=1, noise band about 1.3 CER points), M2 Ultra, language set to ja, load and warm-up excluded, runs serialized. mlx = mlx-whisper, cpp = whisper.cpp 1.9.1 (Metal), ifw = insanely-fast-
whisper (torch/MPS), fw = faster-whisper 1.2.1 (CPU only), v3 = large-v3. Source: whisper.md.
